newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai snake charmer loses charm, strangled by python.
newsitem.headline: Thai snake charmer loses charm, strangled by python.

text.p: A Thai man who considered himself a snake charmer ran out of luck and was strangled to death by a 3.5 metre (11.5 foot) boa constrictor, police said on Monday.
Manee Saisin, a 35-year-old construction worker, was strangled to death late on Saturday by the boa in Phetchaburi, about 150 km (90 miles) south of Bangkok, police said.
Manee, known in the area as a snake catcher and charmer, had rushed to see the snake after friends told him the huge serpent had been spotted on the side of one of the city's main roads, police said.
A friend of the snake charmer told police that Manee, who had recently caught several snakes for food, snared the constrictor and put it around his neck.

As he and his friends were walking home, Manee suddenly cried for help, the friend said. The friends rushed to get help but when they returned with police officers they found Manee strangled to death, police said.
